scope: all current and future material Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse chats, agents, workflows and engineering lanes
purpose: Reduce end-to-end execution latency by reusing canonical current state, limiting context to the task delta, parallelizing safe read-only retrieval and reusing fresh evidence without weakening truth, security, quality, release, production-readback or learning obligations.

FAST.retrieval: hot-state first; fetch only missing or expired evidence
FAST.tests: targeted plus mandatory release gates when mutation occurs

STANDARD.retrieval: canonical current state plus scoped delta evidence
STANDARD.tests: changed-scope tests plus declared dependencies and mandatory release gates

DEEP.retrieval: full relevant evidence classes with direct platform observation where required
DEEP.tests: full relevant regression, security, migration, rollback and production verification

forbidden: reloading complete historical chat transcripts when canonical current state suffices
reparsing unrelated learning shards for a scoped task
passing unbounded tool responses into reasoning
creating a second persistent memory or truth store for speed

serialize: writes to the same canonical state
readback that depends on a mutation

learning_rule: Every material latency regression, cache invalidation defect, stale-evidence incident, unnecessary repeated retrieval, excessive context or avoidable serial wait becomes a canonical learning with root cause, fix, prevention and measurable before/after evidence where available.
safety_rule: Performance optimization may remove redundant work, not required work. Security, identity, truth, quality, exact-candidate, permission, rollback, production-readback and learning gates remain authoritative.
